records.title: Fire Injuries And Fire Fatalities, Annual
records.footnote: Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 1.5.1/11.5.1/13.1.1.

row.footnote: The cases of fire injuries include only patients who require hospital admission following conveyance by Singapore Civil Defence Force.  Light injuries involving minor cuts/abrasions and mild smoke inhalation where patients do not require hospital admission are excluded from the statistics

Singapore Civil Defence Force classifies fire fatalities as deaths resultant from the direct effects of burns, smoke inhalation, or both.  Any fatality pending investigations are excluded from the annual figures released.

Rates are based on the corresponding mid-year population of each year.  Data are used for SDG 1.5.1/11.5.1/13.1.1 'Number of deaths, missing persons and directly affected persons attributed to disasters per 100,000 population'.
